fields.statement: Change set 01M6WHT (plan workflow ends a run on a CI flake) serves no intent yet. Which intent should it serve? / ship check already reruns a head's failed Actions jobs once (ci-rerun-once-per-head). In run 01M6VY5APJP9 that rerun fired and both flaky specs failed again; a third attempt passed. How should the plan workflow get its extra rerun? / When a check stays red after the reruns, how should ship check say the failure is unrelated to the plan? / Should a .rhiza-only PR whose app tests stay red after the reruns still end the run failed?
